overview.description: The FullerThaler Behavioral Growth ETF (FTG) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in mid cap equity. BHAV is an actively managed ETF investing in US mid-cap growth stocks identified through a proprietary behavioral finance lens  specifically focusing on investors under-reaction to positive news. Holdings may grow and be maintained as large-cap exposure. FTG was launched on Aug 18, 2026 and is issued by FullerThaler.

holdings.infoBox: FTG is an equity ETF with a total of 48 individual holdings. The top holdings are Atlassian stock at 4.47%, Fortinet at 3.59%, Comfort Systems USA at 3.43%, Sandisk at 3.17%, and Snowflake at 3.10%.
